biggest_catch: The headline $2,000 requires depositing and holding $250,000–$499,999 for 3+ months — for the app's audience the realistic tier is $1,000 (needs $50,000 parked). The $50/month maintenance fee bites unless you hold $100,000+ in combined balances.
catches: Bonus is tiered by balance, not flat: $1,000 for $50,000–$99,999; $1,500 for $100,000–$249,999; $2,000 for $250,000–$499,999; $3,000 for $500,000+. The route's claimed $500 low end is wrong — the minimum tier is $1,000.
You must deposit/invest within 30 days of account opening and maintain the balance for 3 full consecutive months.
Premier checking carries a $50 monthly maintenance fee unless you meet Premier qualification criteria (e.g., $100,000 in combined U.S. dollar personal deposit and investment balances).
Open by December 31, 2026; bonus paid within 8 weeks after all requirements are met.
Must remain opted in to HSBC marketing emails.
Investment balances used to qualify are not FDIC insured and may lose value.
Products and services may vary by state and are not available in all states.

steps: Go to the official HSBC Premier offer page https://www.us.hsbc.com/checking-accounts/campaigns/premier-relationship/ and review the tier table to pick the bonus tier you can actually fund.
Open a new HSBC Premier checking account online by December 31, 2026 — you must be 18+ and a U.S. resident.
Within 30 days of account opening, deposit and/or invest the amount for your target tier (e.g., $250,000–$499,999 for the $2,000 bonus; $50,000–$99,999 for the $1,000 bonus).
Maintain that qualifying balance for 3 full consecutive months — do not let it dip below your tier's floor.
Remain opted in to receive HSBC marketing emails for the duration.
After all requirements are met, the bonus is paid within 8 weeks; keep the account open until it lands.
To avoid the $50 monthly fee afterward, meet Premier qualification criteria (e.g., $100,000 in combined balances) or plan to close/move funds.
timing: Bonus paid within 8 weeks after all offer requirements are met.
